comments.author: snowframe.
comments.body_html:
Hey guys just figured out how to fix it, as @acidphantasm stated below, the mod currently errors due to the code stating “~4.0.3” or higher. It’s a really easy fix (not for me though it took ages to comb through it)

I’ve uploaded a fix on github that you can download to replace your TEP300headset.dll file (https://github.com/snowframex/TEP300headset-fix), otherwise you can do it yourself below

To fix this:

  1. open “TEP300headset.dll” with a .dll editor like dnSpyEx (not dnSpy though, it’s discontinued) (Notepad won’t work)
  2. open this path/dropdown with the editor:

TEP300headset

TEP300headset.dll (looks pink)

TEP300headset (looks yellow)

ModMetadata

ModMetadata()

  1. Click it, find line 15, which should say this:

this.SptVersion = new Range(“~4.0.3“, false);

  1. Right click > Edit IL Instructions
  2. Edit line 28 to say your version (as below) “4.0.2”
  • Ctrl + Shift + S (Save All)

Now it works! Ragman sells it @ Tier 2 for 92k Roubles Hope this helps someone (or the dev)
